reviews.name: Abdulhamid Aljamie
reviews.textTranslated: In the name of God, what God wills

subTitle: Islamische Gemeinde in Sachsen Alrahman Moschee e.v
title: Al Rahman Mosque

reviews.name: Fahri Mutlu
reviews.text: Yanlışlıkla diğer al rahman camisine gittik cuma namazı için,  cami cameati ve Arapça almanca konuşulduğu için yabancılık çekiyorsun,  almanya da hep diyanetin camisini öneririm.
reviews.textTranslated: We accidentally went to the other Al-Rahman Mosque for Friday prayers. The congregation spoke Arabic and German, so you feel like a stranger. In Germany, I always recommend the mosques run by the Turkish Religious Affairs Directorate.

reviews.name: Merna Emara
reviews.text: There is a place for women to make Wudu and pray on the last floor

title: DITIB-Türkisch islamische Gemeinde zu Leipzig e.V.

reviews.name: Zehra Yazıcı
reviews.text: Çok temiz ve birçok milletten insanı ibadet ile birleştiren bir yer. Hep geleceğiz.
reviews.textTranslated: It's a very clean place that unites people from many nations through worship. We will always come back.

reviews.name: Sajo_ M
reviews.text: Ein Ort, an dem die Seele neue Kraft schöpft und man beim Lauschen der Rezitation des Heiligen Korans Frieden findet. Menschen aus verschiedenen Kulturen und Ländern begegnen sich hier und verstehen einander durch Blicke. Ich bin sehr glücklich, diesen Ort zu besuchen, an dem ich Ruhe vom Alltagsstress finde.
reviews.textTranslated: A place where the soul finds new strength and peace while listening to the recitation of the Holy Quran. People from different cultures and countries meet here and understand each other through glances. I am very happy to visit this place, where I find respite from the stresses of everyday life.

reviews.name: Numan Aksakal
reviews.text:
Temiz, nezih bir cami.
2026 yılı itibariyle cuma namazları yaz saatinde 13:30, kış saatinde 12:30 da başlıyor. Hutbeler Türkçe ve Almanca. Tabii ki konuyla ilgili ayet ve hadislerin ilk başta Arapçası da okunuyor.
reviews.textTranslated:
A clean, respectable mosque.
As of 2026, Friday prayers start at 13:30 in summer time and 12:30 in winter time. Sermons are in Turkish and German. Of course, the Arabic originals of the relevant verses and hadiths are also read first.

reviews.name: Thuraia Othman
reviews.text: كان الاكل كثير طيب ونظيف مرتب المطعم
reviews.textTranslated: The food was very tasty, clean, and the restaurant was well-organized.
